INSTRUCTIONS: Copy this file, rename it, edit params.
Reference in a run file as: sensors/PSR/my_PSR

PARAM_DOCS.frequency_hz: Operating frequency in Hz. S-band=2.8e9, C-band=5.6e9, X-band=9e9. Higher freq = better resolution but worse weather performance. If omitted, defaults to 2.8e9 for PSR.
PARAM_DOCS.rpm: Rotation rate (RPM). DASR=12.5, ASR=15. Determines scan period.
PARAM_DOCS.fov: [azimuth_deg, elevation_deg]. Wider az = more coverage per step.
PARAM_DOCS.tilt: Antenna tilt (deg). Positive = up. Adjusts elevation center.
PARAM_DOCS.far: False alarm rate. 1e-6 typical. Lower = fewer ghost detections.
PARAM_DOCS.rangeRes: Range resolution (m). 93m typical. Smaller = better discrimination.
PARAM_DOCS.mountingLoc: [x,y,z] NED offset from platform. z=-15 means 15m above ground.

name: Primary Search Radar (DASR)
